values.note: 30-amp power and water C$52; 30-amp full service or 50-amp power and water C$55; plus 5% tax. Rates cover 2 adults and 4 children, or 4 adults, one RV and one vehicle. Extended-stay rate by phone. Cancelling more than 48 hours before 8 am on the arrival day refunds less the C$6 Campspot fee, a C$15 processing fee and tax; later, one night is charged. Bear Creek Folk Festival weekend bookings are non-refundable.

note: Rotary Club of Grande Prairie campground beside Bear Creek and the Muskoseepi Park trails, built from 1967 on land the city provided; its profits go back into the community. Sites 22-41 (except 34) have fire pits and a playground. A grocery store and a casino are across the street. No tents. --Claude

flags: PIN MOVE: stored 55.17970,-118.81760 is in the Bear Creek channel; the campground's three loops lie on the west bank between the creek and Highway 43/100 Avenue. Site centre on Esri imagery ~55.1797,-118.8192 (about 100 m west). Recommend 55.17970,-118.81920.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): Bear Creek runs along the east side of the loops; the nearest pads are ~35-55 m from the channel with a band of trees and shrubs (and the creek trail) between. Not waterfront; at most a creek view from the north loop's east edge, which no page claims.
OWNERSHIP: Rotary Club of Grande Prairie on land the city provided (stored note); local per the Alberta rule for service-club campgrounds on municipal land - unchanged.
LONG STAY: '*NEW - CALL US IF YOUR INTERESTED IN OUR EXTENDED STAY RATE!' - an extended-stay rate by phone; nightly sites are sold on Campspot. No concern.

PHONE: (780) 532-1137 (stored) confirmed on the contact page. WEBSITE: https://www.gprotary.com/campground/ answered 200; the stored campspot.com/park/... marketplace link could be replaced by the club's own booking link https://www.campspot.com/book/grande-prairie-rotary (now booking.url).
